responsibility: Defines the stabs-in-ELF debugging configuration for ELF targets supporting -gstabs. It enables DBX debugging info and sets ELF/Solaris-style stabs conventions such as function-relative block and line addresses, function-first emission, N_BINCL include tracking, unlimited stab string continuation, and a terminating null N_SO entry for object-file end marking. Its role is declarative debug-format policy for ELF targets rather than implementation of the DWARF or stabs writers.
